$comment: Generated by scripts/conformance/emit-catalogue.ts from scripts/conformance/catalogue.ts. The seed for profile.json: status in/out/candidate per feature, the decision it comes from, what the pipeline does today, and the keys a validator/shim table matches on.

decisions.D3: A feature is in when every client draws it; :hover is the exception (progressive enhancement)
decisions.D3a: v1: canvas 2D; Web Animations, filter, backdrop-filter if clients draw them; out: forms, inner scroll, 3D transforms, magic move; CSS animations and transitions in
decisions.D3b: Fonts: system generic families only, other names dropped
decisions.D4: Input: taps in the PoC, drag in v1, keyboard later
decisions.D5: strict policy everywhere; webAnimations and morphUpdates from the profile
decisions.D8: SDK outward: openLink / openTelegramLink on a tap with confirmation, haptics; no sendMessage
decisions.D11: One widget model: classic DOM in the sandbox
decisions.D12a: Above the cap: hard clip, no fullscreen
decisions.D17: State: localStorage per (account, bot, message_id), 16 KB, QuotaExceededError; sessionStorage in memory
decisions.D20: .tgw = gzip of HTML, 128 KB HTML limit on the server
decisions.D23: Runtime profile detection: TelegramWidget.profile / isProfileAtLeast, CSS.supports and @supports from the profile
decisions.brief: Named as a candidate in the conformance brief (decided by measurement)
decisions.inv1: Invariant 1: widget JS only in QuickJS
decisions.inv2: Invariant 2: the host validates everything against the allowlists
decisions.inv4: Invariant 4: only data: images, host blob: and #fragment URLs reach the renderer
decisions.today: Current pipeline behaviour, no v1 decision recorded
decisions.proposed: Proposed by this catalogue, to be confirmed

features.title: div, span, p, br, hr, wbr
h1–h6 with UA default sizes and margins
header, footer, main, nav, section, article, aside, hgroup, search, address
Inline text semantics with UA styles: b, i, u, s, em, strong, small, mark, code, kbd, samp, var, abbr, cite, q, del, ins, dfn, time, data
pre (monospace, preserved white space and line breaks)
ul, ol, li, dl, dt, dd, menu with markers
table, thead, tbody, tfoot, tr, td, th, caption, colgroup, col; colspan/rowspan
ruby, rt, rp, bdi, bdo

features.title: Legacy presentational elements: center, font, big, tt, strike, nobr
features.note: Allowed today; a profile could drop them (render as span) to keep the table small.

features.title: with a data: PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP; width/height attributes

features.note: Release plan, security stream: restrict image formats to PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP (the decoder runs in the app process).

features.title: with data: AVIF, BMP, ICO
features.neutralise: url-policy refuses the MIME: placeholder image
features.note: Release plan, security stream 7.

features.title: <canvas> element (2D context through the command stream)
<button> as a tappable box with UA look
details/summary: open state and toggle on tap
features.note: Probes: drawn by Blitz and litehtml; it is a disclosure, not a form.

features.title: <a href="https://…">: href becomes "#" + data-tg-link, the tap goes to openLink (with a gesture)
Form controls: form, input (all types), select, option, optgroup, textarea, label, fieldset, legend, datalist, output
features.neutralise: not decided: drop the control (no box) or render it as an inert span; the tests expect "no control is drawn"
features.note: Kept and drawn natively today.

features.title: progress, meter (native gauges)
features.note: Not input, but a native control look that differs per platform.

features.title: dialog (show/showModal), popover attribute
features.neutralise: drop the methods and the popover attributes; a dialog renders as a block
features.note: The top layer is the page: in the Shadow DOM renderer a modal dialog or popover is drawn over the whole chat, outside the bubble.

features.title: Unknown / custom elements render as an inert <span data-tg-tag>
script (as DOM), iframe, frame, object, embed, link, meta, base, portal, template, slot, math, fencedframe, …
class, id, title, hidden, lang, style attribute
data-* and aria-* attributes (selectors, attr()); no a11y semantics in v1

features.title: align, valign, bgcolor, border, cellpadding, cellspacing, color, face, nowrap

contenteditable, spellcheck, inputmode, enterkeyhint, autocapitalize

features.title: draggable (HTML drag and drop)

features.title: SMIL animation: animate, animateTransform, animateMotion

features.title: cursor (desktop only)

features.title: Units px, em, rem, %, ch, ex; pt/cm/mm/in

features.title: vh / dvh / svh / vb: height-relative units

features.note: Missing in the litehtml prototype.

features.title: Type, class, id, universal and attribute selectors; descendant, child, + and ~ combinators; selector lists
:has()
